text: Which hepatocyte-specific enzymes (single-cell) stain strongly in liver hepatocytes and are not secreted into the blood?
plan: Protein class: Enzymes AND Cell type category (scRNA): Hepatocytes / Cell type enriched AND Tissue expression (IHC): Liver / hepatocytes / High AND NOT Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood
understanding: Identify genes that are enzymes, have hepatocyte-specific expression at the single-cell RNA level, stain strongly (High) in liver hepatocytes by immunohistochemistry (IHC), and are not annotated as secreted to blood.

trail.why: Selecting the class 'Enzymes' without restricting the subclass captures all enzymes as requested.

The requirement specifies 'hepatocyte-specific' based on single-cell RNA-seq, which corresponds to selecting Hepatocytes at level 1 and the specificity category 'Cell type enriched' (defined as at least four-fold higher mRNA compared to any other cell type) at level 2.
The requirement asks for strong staining in liver hepatocytes, which corresponds to tissue liver, cell type hepatocytes, and IHC expression High.
The requirement specifies proteins that are secreted to the blood (which will be excluded) to ensure the query returns only those not secreted into the blood.

requirements.why: Selects genes belonging to the enzyme class.
Captures RNA specificity across single-cell types, specifically for Hepatocytes.
Filters for immunohistochemistry staining level (High) in liver tissue hepatocytes.
Excludes proteins classified under Secreted to blood in the secretome annotation.
